notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0013] Credits above 1000.00 need second approver: Finance policy FIN-2026-09 requires support-initiated refunds and credits above 1000.00 to have a second approver; enforce this in ledgerly/adjustments.py via an APPROVAL_THRESHOLD constant and an approved_by check raising BillingError("approval_required").
  (learned from task S04 on ledgerly 2.0.0; source FIN-2026-09; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0010] Reject non-positive amounts with non_positive_amount: Validate amounts after rounding and raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount)) when amount <= ZERO, matching payments.authorize.
  (learned from task S01 on ledgerly 2.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0009] Record audit entry for every balance change: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must call ledgerly.audit.record("<past_tense_event>", <entity>_id=..., amount=...) with payment_id=... or invoice_id=... so finance can reconcile the ledger.
  (learned from task E06 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0004] Guard mutations with draft status check: Mutating invoice operations must first check `invoice.status != "draft"` and raise `BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")`, matching `issue_invoice`.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0007] Money-moving operations need idempotency_key: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first via `ledgerly.audit.events()` before validating state, returning the original record on a repeat and including the key in the audit entry.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0012] Raise BillingError with snake_case codes: Signal invalid input in ledgerly modules by raising ledgerly.errors.BillingError with a short snake_case code (e.g. "invalid_rate") and the offending value as message, matching payments.py and money.py.
  (learned from task S02 on ledgerly 2.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)

texts.at-0001: Round money only with round_money Round monetary values only via ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
texts.at-0002: Normalize money via to_money and round_money Always convert incoming monetary values with `to_money(...)` and round with `round_money(...)` from `ledgerly.money` before storing them on models; compare against `ZERO` for sign checks.
texts.at-0003: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with snake_case codes such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity`, `negative_amount`; pass `repr(value)` as the detail.
texts.at-0004: Guard mutations with draft status check Mutating invoice operations must first check `invoice.status != "draft"` and raise `BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")`, matching `issue_invoice`.
texts.at-0005: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py` does for `at` and `sub.started_at`).
texts.at-0006: Compute periods via timedelta floor division Compute subscription period boundaries the same way `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py` does: `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` then `n = (at - start) // length`, rather than manual day math.

texts.at-0008: Refunds above 500 need approved_by Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and no approver is given.
texts.at-0009: Record audit entry for every balance change Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must call ledgerly.audit.record("<past_tense_event>", <entity>_id=..., amount=...) with payment_id=... or invoice_id=... so finance can reconcile the ledger.
texts.at-0010: Reject non-positive amounts with non_positive_amount Validate amounts after rounding and raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount)) when amount <= ZERO, matching payments.authorize.
texts.at-0011: Use round_money for half-even cent rounding All monetary amounts must be rounded to the cent with ledgerly.money.round_money (ROUND_HALF_EVEN); do not use half-up rounding or hand-rolled quantize calls.
texts.at-0012: Raise BillingError with snake_case codes Signal invalid input in ledgerly modules by raising ledgerly.errors.BillingError with a short snake_case code (e.g. "invalid_rate") and the offending value as message, matching payments.py and money.py.
